title: SAVA Gelaro SF6 review
notes: Independent exact-model review, not a manufacturer measurement. It reports the Gelaro SF6 frame at approximately 1,100 g without size, finish, hardware inclusion or weighing method, and describes the carbon chassis as damping road vibration while remaining responsive. These are approximate weight and qualitative ride observations, not controlled frame-stiffness measurements, and are not transferred to sibling Gelaro variants.
